author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.8 shipped: Lights fade on every ambient path; order-proof test suite
summary: Lights fade on every ambient path; order-proof test suite
why: Operator asked for a 1-2s fade on all light actuation because it reads as higher quality. The room fade knobs already existed and entry/exit used them, but five paths (Room lights switch, away sweep, shared-space off, reconciler dispatch) sent bare on/off, so lights snapped. Reusing the existing knobs keeps one setting per room; alerts stay instant because a fade blunts a warning, and relays cannot fade at all.
implications: Shipped LIGHT-TRANSITION-COVERAGE-1, SNAP1-FRIGATE-TRAVERSAL-1 at v5.108.8; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.8.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a room sets fade above 5s (LIGHT-FADE-OVER-5S-MANUAL-MISREAD-1) or a device mishandles transition.

refs.release_notes: Room fade now applied on Room lights switch, Away leave-on sweep, shared-space off and reconciler dispatch (light.* only; alerts instant; relays never). Test-order pollution fixes + xdist split hook (tests only). Hermetic SNAP1 traversal test.
